name: 11-zod-ulid-regex
title: Simplify the ULID regex to a single character class
body: Expresses `regexes.ulid` as 26 characters from the Crockford base32 alphabet (case-insensitive, excluding I, L, O and U) instead of special-casing the first character.

bugs.why: A ULID is 128 bits in 26 base32 chars, so the first character must be 0-7; allowing the full alphabet accepts overflowing strings like "8ZZZ..." that ULID decoders reject.
